semiconductor_relevance: High — Fine Silicon Manufacturing specializes in silicon wafer processing and reclaiming services, which are critical for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Fine Silicon Manufacturing (Shanghai) Ltd. is a leading provider of silicon wafer processing and reclaiming services, with a focus on dummy and test wafers of various sizes. The company also offers customized coating services and is expanding its capabilities in third-generation semiconductor materials.
capabilities: Wafer reclaim services for 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch wafers
Customized coating services including thermal oxide and LP-Nitride
Development of third-generation semiconductor materials such as SiC and lithium tantalate

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in the Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone, Shanghai, with significant manufacturing capabilities.
regional_presence.Japan: Operates a subsidiary, KOD Co., Ltd., in Tokyo, enhancing its regional market presence.
